name: fusione-guidata
description: Vera P0 merger case foundation: evidence, explicit facts, version-bound decisions and change impacts. Legal execution branches are unsupported.

interface.longDescription: Organize a multi-company merger case with explicit imports, known/unknown/disputed facts, source versions, recorded professional confirmations and selective review after input changes. P0 does not calculate exchange ratios, apply legal branches, sign or file.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a synthetic merger case demonstration and show the impact of an input change.
